intent: Each trace records, for every agent process, its program, model, tokens, cost and time, and for every check its time and exit status, so that cost per verified candidate = (Σ_c (g(c) + k(c)) + r·t) / v, with r the rate in bon.toml and t the time charged to the search.

A skill ships with the CLI for the model engineer talks to: how to work at the spec level and when to run bon, read from the bon.toml, queue and spec of the repo it runs in; agent processes never see it.
Background work, compaction and counterexample searches on trunk, runs only on spare capacity, stalest first, staleness being trunk commits since that kind last ran.
Programs may run the kernel's gates compiled in, in any language, with no trusted code beyond their entry points.

The view (bon in a terminal) shows the host: what waits on engineer and what that waiting costs, the agent processes and checks running against agent_processes and check_processes, memory, each bon process with those of identical tree together, and a journal; run in a repository it shows only that one, and its tabs stay inside it.

A test fails when a surface name (a spec item, a gate contract, a kernel public item, an emitted type, a trace word, a manifest or host key) is undefined or names two things; a candidate's new identifiers may be scored, fewer ranking higher.
A search may carry earlier searches' verdicts on its goal in its context (Search.context); a counterexample's or a foil's context never holds check output from a member.

The view shows, from the traces, each kind's success probability per agent process and per attempt, and by attempt, agent processes per behavior, the utilization of agent_processes and check_processes against wall time, interrupt turnaround, and the run-time distribution: time and cost to a push as a fixed part plus a part per distinct tree.
The view reports cost per verified candidate by kind and model; a benchmark compares two programs on the same goal at one dollar limit.

For an accepted intent, a spec search's agent processes each propose a spec change; the verified ones are grouped by behavior, nothing is pushed, and it ends in a proposal reviewed as new words, decisions, reach and scenarios, the splits between them being the decisions.
